text:
Maria G: Kickoff for VelvetHealth dedicated rollout — planning to cut traffic 2026-06-05 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need go/no-go, KMS pin, and verification checklist.

deploy-bot: CI ✅ smoke tests passed, canary image built: rh-inference/velvet-2026-06-05:v1.4.2-quant. Canary job id: cb-9823. Link: https://ci.redwood/CB/9823

Alex K: tagging in — I want to pin model runtime to v1.4.2-quant on dedicated slice A. Can we keep v1.3.8 as fallback with traffic steering?

Rajesh (SRE): agree on pin + fallback. Need explicit latency SLO for canary: 95th < 220ms. If > 300ms for 5m, automatic rollback. Also watch KV cache hit rate — if < 60% on canary, abort.

Lydia P: release notes posted: https://confluence.redwood/release/velvet-2026-06-05 — callouts for tokenization change and new quant path. QA found one prompt regression in billing flow (low severity) — details in notes.

Maria G: Thanks. Ops question: KMS scope — must we rotate keys during cutover? VelvetHealth compliance asked keys be pinned for the window. Olga, can you confirm?

Olga T: Confirmed with security: we will pin KMS key velvet-prod-2025 until 06-06 00:00 UTC. No rotation during cutover. I've granted service account sa-velvet-dedicated access.

Alex K: Canary rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% spaced 10m apart, manual pause at each step. Rollback criteria: error rate spike >1% or latency rule from Rajesh.

deploy-bot: Deploy command queued:
```
deploy --customer velvethealth --pool dedicated-east-1 --image rh-inference/velvet-2026-06-05:v1.4.2-quant --canary 5 --pause 600
```

Rajesh (SRE): Add a post-release smoke that hits billing and auth endpoints (10 concurrent reqs for 2m). If any 5xx or auth failures, abort and roll back.

Maria G: I've added those smoke scripts to the runbook and updated the rollback playbook. PR: https://git.redwood/release/runbooks/pull/412 — please ack.

Lydia P: Acked. Also adding a monitoring alert to the console dashboard: VelvetHealth / model v1.4.2 - canary errors and KV hit rate.

Alex K: One more — model weights checksum included in release notes, verifier script ready: `sha256sum velvet-v1.4.2.weights` — match before flip.

Olga T: Security ack for KMS pin and SA perms :thumbsup:

Maria G: All approvals in thread. Tentative go at 02:00 UTC 2026-06-05. If nobody objects in next 24h, we'll proceed.

deploy-bot: Scheduling window booked on calendar: Jun 05 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary job cb-9823 will run at start.

Rajesh (SRE): I'll be on pager for the window and will trigger rollback if thresholds hit.

Alex K: Sounds good, +1.

Maria G: Great — thanks team. I'll post final runbook link and call number 30m before start.

Olga T: Oncall for security during window: olga-rotation.

Lydia P: I'll monitor metrics and post updates in #prod-observability.

Maria G: Closing thread for now — will reopen with preflight results. :white_check_mark:
